title: Një bisedë

source.title: Albanian beginner dialogue 1 (course-authored)
source.author: Go course authors (first draft by an AI assistant at the authors’ request)

sourceNote: Written for the course authors as a beginner seed text. The drafter was an AI assistant (Claude), not a native speaker: the text is simple and deliberately repetitive but has NOT been reviewed by a native speaker and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English glosses are the drafter's own. Have a native speaker review it before release.

sentences.text: Jam mirë, Pavli, por nuk e kuptoj një gjë.
sentences.english: I am fine, Pavli, but I do not understand one thing.

sentences.text: Nuk e kuptoj pse Perëndia e fal mëkatin.
sentences.english: I do not understand why God forgives sin.

sentences.text: Po, besoj te Perëndia me gjithë zemër.
sentences.english: Yes, I believe in God with all my heart.

sentences.text: Faleminderit, Pavli, edhe unë dua të besoj te Perëndia.
sentences.english: Thank you, Pavli, I also want to believe in God.
